cases.sentence: Ну, конечно, все они считают меня ___.
cases.explain: «дурным человеком» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Well, of course, they all consider me a bad person. In the morning and hung over as I’ve been, I’m of the very same opinion about myself. But, after all, it’s impossible to trust the opinion ofa person who hasn't yet been able to tie one on. On the other hand, what chasms open up in me in the evening, if I’ve gotten good and looped during the day. What chasms.

cases.sentence: Утром плохо, а вечером хорошо – ___ дурного человека.
cases.explain: «верный признак» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: But, so what. So what if I’m a bad person. I’ve noticed that, in general, ifa person feels nasty in the morning but is full of plans and dreams and vigor in the evening, he’s a very bad person. Mornings, rotten; evenings, fine—a sure sign of a bad type. But take someone who’s full of energy and hope in the morning, but overwhelmed with exhaus- tion in the evening—for sure he’s a trashy, narrow-minded mediocrity. That sort of person is disgusting to me. I don't know how he strikes you, but to me he’s disgusting.

cases.sentence: Потому что магазины у нас работают до девяти, а Елисеевский – тот даже до одиннадцати, и если ты не подонок, ты всегда сумеешь к вечеру подняться до чего-нибудь, до какой-нибудь ___…
cases.explain: «пустяшной бездны» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Of course, there are those for whom morning and evening are equally pleasing, who are equally pleased by sunrise and by sunset. These are simply bastards. It’s sickening even to talk about them. But then, if someone is equally repulsed by morning and evening, I really don't know what to say about him. That's the ultimate cocksucking scum. Because our stores stay open till nine and you can always get something at the big Eliseev grocery up till eleven, so if you’re not scum, by evening you'll always be able to create some sort of little chasm.

cases.sentence: И, весь в ___, Господь мне ответил:
cases.explain: «синих молниях» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: And, all in blue flashes of lightning, the Lord answered me:
